locator.section: web/www/missa/Latin/Sancti/02-02.txt [Tractus], tract-only lines 185–188; preceding gradual excluded

entries.claim: The exact pinned direct Latin Mass body at lines 185–188 corroborates the complete 31-word Tract as a derived digital witness. The same runtime section also contains the preceding Gradual, excluded here; no inherited reference or expansion supplies this body.

The complete 31-word Tract body has been checked directly on the Benziger Brothers 1962 Editio iuxta typicam page, printed p. 467, leaf n548. It replaces Alleluia and its verse after Septuagesima; the preceding Gradual remains separate. This states current conformity, not original transcription genesis.
